text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
August ×, Night. Wind: Still. "A ship 
without crewmates is just..." 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Leaving their peers behind and devoting 
themselves entirely to being my Trainer 
just to make me win... Seeing my Trainer's 
resolve, my mind was made up.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The expedition to the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe is off! I won't let anyone steal 
away the time I spend with the people I 
love. Isn't that the whole reason I'm 
aiming for the castle in the first place?!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
I ended up breaking my promise to the 
lender as a result, but a debt of 
gratitude has to be repaid. Besides, 
building an eternal castle purely through 
domestic activities poses its own set of 
challenges.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I've given up on my dream, 
but... our ship might be in a bit of 
trouble.
